summary: Agent-guessed forms (issues comment, issues update, a positional issue on comments add, --labels) reuse the canonical handlers, --label refuses a label name before any API call, and every failure, including a failed --deliver, reaches the root error finalizer.
reason: Agents lost turns to these guesses, and a failure that returned before the finalizer exited non-zero with no JSON error under --agent, so agents retried blind and once filed a duplicate issue.
validated_outcome: Process-level tests through Execute show exactly one JSON error envelope and a non-zero exit for a missing label name, a label name passed to --label (with no Linear request), unknown commands and subcommands, and a failed webhook delivery.
